s: December 19, 2023 - They are more likely to buy from you if they like you. They absolutely must trust you will deliver on your promises. Whilst Ivan was talking about this in a referral context, it is very true in a marketing and sales context too. Very few of us now do something nobody else does, so we all have competition. Competition that competes on price, location, number of awards and in many other ways. But, more and more, the factor that makes you stand out is the ‘Why’. People can see what you do and, probably, how you do it, but the reason many buy from you now is because of why you do what you do.
